facts.title: Lexical and schema collection
facts.fact: First-line BOM removal, physical comment/blank skip and subsequent first-# suffix deletion precede ordinary attribute collection. A space followed by # within ordinary section becomes invalid empty attribute, unlike specialized prepped-line loops. Ordinary repeated attributes overwrite; ^ fields accumulate; valid unknown schema attributes are ignored. Fixed schema ignores excess tail, q consumes preprocessed original string. Escaped-quote marker removal is positional; ordinary CSV quotation is not a general unquote guarantee.

facts.fact: Game.load(save_data) applies saved values/maps rather than recompiling or calling GameData.load_all. Pokemon::Move holds ID/PP/PPUp but queries data fields and totalPP live by ID. AIMove wraps this existing battle object, sets calcType and moldBreaker during setup and uses skill-dependent own handlers/callbacks. Registry reload cannot be generalized to refresh all existing battle snapshots, caches or old data instances.
